turns.utterance: Hold a calibrated anemometer probe at the extraction port inlet while the extraction unit is running at operating duty cycle. Record the air velocity and calculate volumetric flow rate, then compare against the minimum extraction flow rate specified for this laser power class.

ground_truth.node_text: Hold a calibrated anemometer probe at the extraction port inlet while the extraction unit is running at the operating duty cycle. Record the air velocity in metres per second and calculate volumetric flow rate from the duct cross sectional area. Compare against the minimum extraction flow rate specified for this laser power class in the safety datasheet.

turns.utterance: I'm getting the right flow rate, but there's a really strong burning smell coming from the extraction duct itself, like the filter media might be overheating or something.

turns.utterance: Air velocity measured and flow rate calculated. I've got the readings recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Hold a calibrated anemometer probe at the extraction port inlet while the extraction unit is running at the operating duty cycle. Record the air velocity in metres per second and calculate volumetric flow rate from the duct cross sectional area. Compare against the minimum extraction flow rate specified for this laser power class in the safety datasheet.

turns.utterance: Is the extraction flow rate above minimum required value?

turns.utterance: Flow rate is comfortably above the minimum threshold.

turns.utterance: Are the galvo mirror surfaces clean and undamaged?

turns.utterance: Both galvo mirrors are clean with no deposits or surface damage visible.

ground_truth.node_text: Galvo mirror surfaces clean and undamaged?

turns.utterance: Are all ten test marks within depth, width, and contrast specification?

turns.utterance: Several of the test marks are showing contrast values below spec limits.

ground_truth.node_text: All 10 test marks within depth, width and contrast specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust mark speed and power for substrate batch compensation.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust mark speed and power for substrate batch compensation

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Parameters adjusted. I've increased power slightly and reduced mark speed.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust mark speed and power for substrate batch compensation

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify test mark quality after parameter adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify test mark quality after parameter adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The marks are still failing contrast spec even after the adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify test mark quality after parameter adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Mark quality is unrecoverable. Escalate this issue for process engineering review and place the station on hold.

turns.utterance: Understood. I'll escalate to process engineering and tag the station as on hold.
